claim: Failure Domain and MTTR Impact on P99 Cost: In self-built architectures, a single POP failure affects a larger percentage of users (10% per POP) compared to public cloud (redundant multi-POP). The cost of downtime is quantified as Downtime_Cost = (Traffic_Share * ARPU * Downtime_Minutes) / Q_day * 1000. For 10% traffic share and 30-min outage, this adds ~0.05-0.1% to the per-1000-request cost, requiring higher redundancy investment.

corrected_claim: 在自建架构中，单个POP故障通常影响较大比例用户（具体比例取决于架构设计，如10%），相比公有云冗余架构风险更高。停机成本可通过流量份额、ARPU及停机时长估算，具体数值需根据实际业务参数计算，通常要求更高的冗余投入以控制P99成本影响。
